title: Classic ASP.NET error page disclosed in a response
description: The response carries the fixed heading of the classic ASP.NET unhandled-exception page. That page prints the exception message, the source line and a stack frame naming the assembly, and it is emitted by default outside a custom-errors configuration.
remediation: Set <customErrors mode="On" /> (or On with a defaultRedirect) in Web.config and return a generic page with a correlation id.
limitation: One response body. The check reads the page heading; it does not decide whether the stack below it names internal paths.

observation.body: Description: An unhandled exception occurred.
An unhandled exception occurred while processing the request. Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics.DeveloperExceptionPageMiddleware
